questions.question: ‘Killing the bird, the old man brought bad luck to the crew’ is a - [SABAS][]
options: complex sentence
compound sentence
simple sentence
none of them
questions.explanation: এতে একটিমাত্র finite verb (brought) এবং একটিমাত্র subject (the old man) থাকায় এটি একটি simple sentence।

questions.question: ‘Without working hard, you will not prosper in life’ is a- [SABAS][]
options: conditional sentence
compound sentence
complex sentence
simple sentence
questions.explanation: এটি একটি simple sentence, কারণ এতে একটিমাত্র clause এবং finite verb (will prosper) আছে।

questions.question: ‘I saw a boy who was poor’ is a- [SABAS][]
options: simple sentence
compound sentence
complex sentence
none of them
questions.explanation: who was poor' একটি subordinate adjective clause, তাই এটি complex sentence।

questions.question: Which one of the following is a compound sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Turning to the left you will see the shop.
If you read you will learn.
I shall work hard or I shall fail.
Had I the wings of a bird?
questions.explanation: দুটি স্বাধীন খণ্ডবাক্য (I shall work hard, I shall fail) 'or' conjunction দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়েছে, তাই এটি compound sentence।

questions.question: “You should apologize for what you have done” is a - [SABAS][]
options: complex sentence
simple sentence
compound sentence
adverbial clause
questions.explanation: what you have done' একটি noun clause (subordinate), তাই পুরো বাক্যটি একটি complex sentence।

questions.question: The girl who sat next to me is an architect. It is a: [SABAS][]
options: simple sentence
complex sentence
compound sentence
complex-compound sentence
questions.explanation: who sat next to me' একটি adjective clause, যা complex sentence গঠন করে।

questions.question: A complex sentence is one which contains [SABAS][]
options: one independent clause and one subordinate clause
two subordinate clause
two independent clauses
neither of the above
questions.explanation: একটি complex sentence-এ কমপক্ষে একটি independent clause এবং একটি subordinate clause থাকে।

questions.question: He is a boy who has his merit. This sentence is- [SABAS][]
options: exclamatory
compound
complex
simple
questions.explanation: who has his merit' একটি subordinate clause, তাই এটি complex sentence।

questions.question: Which of the following is a compound sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Work hard and you will succeed
Work hard for success
If you work hard, you will succeed
You need to be hard working to succeed
questions.explanation: দুটি স্বাধীন খণ্ডবাক্য (independent clauses) 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত হওয়ায় এটি একটি Compound sentence।

questions.question: ‘If we don't read we become trapped in our own individual minds’ is a -. [SABAS][]
options: a simple sentence
an imperative sentence
a complex sentence
an exclamatory sentence
questions.explanation: If' যুক্ত conditional clause থাকায় এটি একটি Complex sentence।

questions.question: Which one is a simple sentence? [SABAS][]
options: If I make a promise I keep it
You can talk as much as you like
While there is life there is hope
He will pay only under compulsion
questions.explanation: বাক্যটিতে একটিমাত্র finite verb (will pay) আছে এবং কোনো subordinate clause নেই, তাই এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: You must work for success. (Make it compound without changing meaning) [SABAS][]
options: Work hard for the success.
Work hard for success.
Work hard to succeed.
Work hard and you will succeed.
questions.explanation: Compound sentence-এ দুটি clause থাকে যা 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত, এখানে 'Work hard' ও 'you will succeed' যুক্ত হয়েছে।

questions.question: Because of illness, he could not attend the meeting. This is a ---- [SABAS][]
options: simple sentence
complex sentence
compound sentence
multiple sentence
questions.explanation: এতে একটিমাত্র finite verb (could not attend) আছে, তাই এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: ‘I saw that the boy was playing.’ It is an example of a – [SABAS][]
options: complex sentence
compound sentence
simple sentence
exclamatory sentence
questions.explanation: that the boy was playing' একটি noun clause, তাই এটি Complex sentence।

questions.question: ‘Besides robbing the poor child, he also murdered her’– this sentence is- [SABAS][]
options: a compound sentence
a simple sentence
a complex sentence
an optative sentence
questions.explanation: Besides robbing' একটি phrase, এবং বাক্যে একটি finite verb (murdered) থাকায় এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: The tiger having fallen, he climbed down from the tree. [SABAS][]
options: complex sentence
simple sentence
compound sentence
negative sentence
questions.explanation: The tiger having fallen' একটি absolute phrase এবং বাক্যে একটি finite verb (climbed) আছে, তাই এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: What is the sentence-pattern of the following sentence? ‘Besides making a promise, he kept it.’ [SABAS][]
options: Complex sentence
Compound sentence
Simple sentence
Negative sentence
questions.explanation: এতে একটিমাত্র clause (he kept it) আছে, তাই এটি Simple sentence।

questions.question: ‘There is no meaning in what you say’ what type of sentence is it? [SABAS][]
options: simple sentence
compound sentence
positive sentence
complex sentence
questions.explanation: what you say' একটি noun clause, যা Complex sentence নির্দেশ করে।

questions.question: Since the water was hot, I could not drink it. (The correct simple sentence of the above complex sentence is -) [SABAS][]
options: The water was very hot, so I could not drink it.
The water being very hot, I could not drink it.
As the water being very hot, I could not drink it.
I could not drink the water because it was hot.
questions.explanation: Complex sentence-এ Since/As থাকলে Simple sentence-এ 'Being' বা 'Having' যুক্ত Phrase বসে।

questions.question: He shut the door and went out. (Make it simple) [SABAS][]
options: Shutting the door, he went out.
He shutting the door before went out.
He went out shutting door.
Closing the door he went out.
questions.explanation: Compound sentence-এ 'and' থাকলে Simple-এ প্রথম verb-এর সাথে -ing যোগ করতে হয়।

questions.question: The man said this and went away. (Complex) [SABAS][]
options: Saying this the man went away
Having said this the man went away
The man went away after he had said this
None of the above
questions.explanation: Simple sentence-কে Complex-এ রূপান্তরের সময় and তুলে দিয়ে দুটি clause করতে হয়।

questions.question: I had done the work and went home (Simple) [SABAS][]
options: Having done the work, I went home
Being done the work, I went home
Because of being done the work, I went home
As I had done the work, I went home
questions.explanation: কাজ শেষ বোঝাতে Having + past participle ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: Though he is poor, he is happy. (Simple) [SABAS][]
options: Despite his poverty, he is happy.
In spite of his being poor, he is unhappy.
He is poor but happy.
In spite of his poorness, he is happy.
questions.explanation: Though/Although যুক্ত Complex sentence-কে Simple করতে 'Despite/In spite of' ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: Though he tried hard, he failed. (Compound) [SABAS][]
options: He tried and failed
In spite of his trying hard, he failed.
He tried hard but failed
But for his trying hard, he failed.
questions.explanation: Though যুক্ত বাক্যকে Compound করার সময় 'but' ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

questions.question: Find the complex form of 'He is poor but honest'. [SABAS][]
options: Although he is poor he is honest
He being poor is honest
Despite his poverty he is honest
In spite his honesty he is poor
questions.explanation: Compound sentence-এ but থাকলে Complex করার সময় Although/Though যোগ করতে হয়।

questions.question: He is poor but honest. (Make it simple) [SABAS][]
options: In spite of his poverty he is honest.
Though he is poor but honest also.
He is poor and honest.
He is poor, so he is honest.
questions.explanation: But যুক্ত বাক্যকে Simple করার সময় In spite of + possessive case + noun ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: He is rich, but he is unhappy'. Make it simple. [SABAS][]
options: Although he is rich but he is unhappy.
In spite of his richness, he is unhappy.
In spite of his riches, he is unhappy.
Though he is rich, he is unhappy.
questions.explanation: Richness-এর চেয়ে Riches (ধন-সম্পদ) শব্দটি অধিক সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

questions.question: Though he is rich, he is not happy. (Make it simple) [SABAS][]
options: He is rich but not happy.
In spite of being a rich man, he is not happy
In spite of a rich man, he is not happy.
In spite of a rich man, he is happy.
questions.explanation: Rich noun নয়, তাই 'In spite of being a rich man' সঠিক গঠন।

questions.question: In spite of being old, he was young at heart.' The compound sentence of it is - [SABAS][]
options: Though he was old he was young at heart
He was too old to be young at heart.
He was old but young at heart.
All of the above
questions.explanation: Compound sentence-এ দুটি clause-কে 'but' দ্বারা যুক্ত করতে হয়।

questions.question: Move and die. (Simple) [SABAS][]
options: If you move, you will die.
By moving you will die.
Without moving you will die.
If you do not move, you will die.
questions.explanation: Imperative sentence-এ 'and' থাকলে Simple sentence-এ 'By + gerund' ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: If he does not move, he will die. (Compound) [SABAS][]
options: Move and die
Move or die
He cannot move and die
Let him move or he will die
questions.explanation: If + negative (Unless) যুক্ত বাক্যকে Compound করতে 'or' ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: Give the simple form of the sentence. 'Study well or you will fail.' [SABAS][]
options: In case of your studying you will fail.
In case of your not studying well you will fail.
Despite your studying well you will fail.
In spite of your studying you will fail.
questions.explanation: Or যুক্ত বাক্যকে Simple করার সময় In case of + negative gerund ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: If he does not do, he will die. (Compound) [SABAS][]
options: Do and die
Do or die
He cannot do and die
Let him do or he will die.
questions.explanation: If clause নেতিবাচক হলে Compound-এ 'or' দ্বারা যুক্ত করতে হয়।

questions.question: Move and die. (Make simple) [SABAS][]
options: Move or Die
In case of your moving you will die.
Move unless you die.
Move never you will die
questions.explanation: Imperative sentence-এ and থাকলে Simple-এ 'By + gerund' হয়।

questions.question: Move or die. (make it simple) [SABAS][]
options: You shall move to die
In case of your failure to move you will die.
If you don't move you will die
You will to move to die
questions.explanation: Or যুক্ত Imperative-কে Simple করতে 'In case of + negative gerund' ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: Choose the simple form of the sentence: If you help me, I will help you. [SABAS][]
options: In case of your helping me I will help you
In case you help me I will help you
By your help I will help you
Despite your help I will help you
questions.explanation: If যুক্ত affirmative sentence-কে Simple করতে 'In case of + possessive + gerund' ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: The complex sentence of 'He is too weak to walk.' is: [SABAS][]
options: He is so weak that he cannot walk
He is very weak to walk
He is so weak to walk
He is to weak to walk
questions.explanation: Too...to যুক্ত sentence-কে Complex করার নিয়ম: so...that + cannot।

questions.question: The man is so weak that he cannot walk (Simple) [SABAS][]
options: The man is too weak to walk
The man is so weak to walk
The man is too weak for him to walk
The man is so weak for him to walk
questions.explanation: So...that + negative clause-কে Simple করার নিয়ম: too...to।

questions.question: He is so dishonest that he cannot speak the truth. (Simple) [SABAS][]
options: He is too dishonest that he cannot speak the truth.
He is too dishonest to be spoken the truth.
He is too dishonest to speak the truth.
He is very dishonest and he cannot speak the truth.
questions.explanation: So...that + cannot-কে Simple করার জন্য too...to ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: The grass was so wet that we could not sit on it. Make it a simple sentence. [SABAS][]
options: The grass was very wet to sit on.
The grass was too wet for us to sit on.
The grass was wet enough for us to sit on.
The grass was much wet for us to sit on.
questions.explanation: Complex sentence-এর subject এবং that clause-এর subject ভিন্ন হলে 'too...for + object + to' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: She is — to reach the shelf. [SABAS][]
options: so tall
tall as
tall enough
too tall
questions.explanation: Adjective + enough + to + verb এই গঠন অনুযায়ী 'tall enough' সঠিক।

questions.question: He is working hard ———————. [SABAS][]
options: as he can shine in life
that he can shine in life
to shine in life
so that he can shine in life
questions.explanation: উদ্দেশ্যমূলক বাক্যে Simple-এ 'to' থাকলেও Complex-এ 'so that' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: ‘In spring, the cuckoo sings’ Make it complex. [SABAS][]
options: When it is spring, the cuckoo sings.
The cuckoo sings in spring.
The cuckoo sings only in spring.
When the spring comes, the cuckoo sings
questions.explanation: সময় নির্দেশক phrase থাকলে 'When + clause' দ্বারা Complex করতে হয়।

questions.question: Does he wish me to go. Which one is complex for this sentence? [SABAS][]
options: Does he want that I should go?
Does he wish my going?
Does he wish that I should go?
Does he wish that I may go?
questions.explanation: Wish/Want যুক্ত Simple বাক্যকে Complex করতে 'that + subject + should + verb' বসে।

questions.question: He wants that I should go. (Make it simple) [SABAS][]
options: He wants my going
He wants me to go.
He wants that I must go
He wants that I might go.
questions.explanation: That clause-কে Simple করতে 'object + to + infinitive' গঠন ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Which is the complex form of ‘They admitted their guilt’? [SABAS][]
options: They admitted that they were guilty
They admitted when they were guilty
They admitted because they were guilty
They admitted, they have guiltiness
questions.explanation: Noun phrase-কে Complex করতে 'that + clause' ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

questions.question: I know her name. (Make it complex) [SABAS][]
options: What her name I know.
I know what is her name.
I know what her name is.
Her name I know.
questions.explanation: Noun phrase-কে Complex করার সময় wh-word বা that এর পরে subject + verb বসে।

[SABAS]
The sentence 'He is diligent, therefore he will succeed' is a-[]
options: compound-complex sentence
compound sentence
simple sentence
complex sentence

[SABAS]

options: After he came here, he talked to him
He came here but I did not talk to him

"The man with a stick in his hand was walking across the road (লোকটা তার হাতে লাঠি নিয়ে হেঁটে রাস্তা পার হচ্ছিল)" This sentence is the example of-[]
